requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE true entails the listed IEEE arithmetic facilities
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE inquires support for IEEE arithmetic for a real kind; for a supported kind, normal numbers match an ISO/IEC/IEEE 60559 format, exact normal addition, subtraction, and multiplication conform for at least one rounding mode, ABS provides abs, IEEE_REM provides remainder, and IEEE_COPY_SIGN, IEEE_LOGB, and IEEE_UNORDERED provide copySign, logB, and compareQuietUnordered.

Unsupported guarded branches are skips, not passes. Processor-dependent support availability, NaN payloads, exact halting mechanics, initial modes, approximation latitude, and IOMSG text are not asserted.
